# Rust-only golden COPC fixture

`rust-only-golden-pf8.copc.laz` is a small, checked-in LAS 1.4 / COPC file
used by `rust_only_golden.rs` and the direct Rust/WASM adapter test. It is
generated by `cargo run -p copc-adapter-core --example
generate_rust_only_golden_fixture` using the Rust `laz` compressor; it is not
generated by or compared against `copc-js`.

The fixture contains a COPC Info VLR, LASzip VLR, WKT1 WGS 84 VLR, one scalar
U16 Extra Bytes field named `survey_code`, a root page with an empty root node
and a reference to a child page, and four LAS point-format 8 records in the
child node. The point fields
are written explicitly by the generator. Tests derive source XYZ from each
integer coordinate multiplied by the declared scale and added to its offset.
Expected WGS 84 ECEF values are independently calculated from the published
WGS 84 semi-major axis and inverse flattening, after the declared 1.25 metre
height correction.

The binary fixture is committed so future Rust-only checks do not depend on a
fixture generator, live dataset, or JavaScript COPC implementation at runtime.
